descriptionEn: Cast iron, high heat, butter basting. Medium-rare or nothing.
descriptionZh: 铸铁锅、大火、黄油淋制。五分熟，别无他选。

stepsEn: Remove steak from fridge 45 min before cooking. Pat completely dry. Season aggressively with salt and pepper on all surfaces — more than you think is needed.
Heat a cast-iron pan over highest heat until smoking. Add oil. Place steak — it should scream when it hits the pan.
Cook 2 min without moving. Flip. Cook 2 min. Then flip every 30 seconds for a final 2 min, building the crust.
Add butter, garlic and herbs. Tilt the pan and baste the steak continuously with the foaming butter for 1 min.
Rest on a wire rack 5–8 min. This is mandatory, not optional. Cut against the grain.
stepsZh: 牛排从冰箱取出后在室温放置45分钟，完全拍干，各面大量撒盐和黑胡椒——比你以为需要的要多。
铸铁锅大火烧至冒烟，下油，放入牛排——下锅时应该发出响亮的嘶嘶声。
不移动煎2分钟，翻面，再煎2分钟，最后每隔30秒翻面共2分钟，积累焦壳。
加黄油、大蒜和香草，倾斜锅身，用起泡的黄油不停淋制牛排约1分钟。
放在烤架上静置5-8分钟，这是必须的而非可选的。逆纹切开。
details.notesEn: Dry surface, ripping-hot pan, aggressive seasoning, proper rest. Every step has a reason. The resting allows the juices to redistribute — cut too early and they run out onto the board, not into your mouth.
details.notesZh: 干燥表面、极热铸铁锅、大量调味、充分静置。每一步都有其理由。静置让肉汁重新分布——切得太早，肉汁流到砧板上，而不是流进你口中。
